newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH OPERATOR SAYS OFFERS FIRST WIRELESS OFFICE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH OPERATOR SAYS OFFERS FIRST WIRELESS OFFICE.

text.p: State-run operator Telecom Finland said on Monday it had launched the world's first switchboard service for cellular phones only, making it possible to build truly wireless offices based on mobile phones.
"The switchboard service makes it possible to build truly mobile and wireless offices since it requires no wired phones or fixed switchboard," Telecom Finland said in a statement.
Its features included serial calls, trasfers, data and telefax services, group alerts, conference calls and a call-back service for mobile phones, it said.
Telecom Finland said the new service could reduce investment needs and improve mobility and cost-efficiency.
It would be available for analog Nordic Mobile Telephone (NMT) 450 and 900 phones and digital Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) phones.
